speaker: Doctor
text: Since I have no prior questions recorded in your history, I will begin our assessment now. Please tell me, how long have you been experiencing these gait and limb ataxia symptoms, and do you have a known history of conditions like multiple sclerosis, syphilis, or heavy alcohol use?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. To determine if this is a structural issue or a metabolic one, have you noticed any weakness, numbness, or changes in your vision, and do you have a history of back pain or trauma? Also, are you taking any new medications or supplements?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast
REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain showing periventricular white matter lesions without enhancement
